SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT PLANT , LEGACY_PO_NO , LEGACY_PO_SEQ FROM TBL_KEP_PO WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY PLANT,LEGACY_PO_NO,LEGACY_PO_SEQ
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'HSRO' AS BUYER , 'KA' AS SITE , '1' AS REVISION , PLANT , LEGACY_PO_NO , LEGACY_PO_SEQ , STATUS , BUYER_ITEM_NO , CURRENCY_CODE , UNIT_PRICE , ITEM_QTY , ITEM_AMT , ADD_DATE , RD_DATE , DELY_TO_LOCATION , PURCHASER_USER_ID , LEGACY_PR_NO , REQ_USER_NAME , REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME , REMARK , DELY_TO_LOCATION_TEXT FROM TBL_KEP_PO WHERE PLANT = '$G_RS.PLANT$' AND LEGACY_PO_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND LEGACY_PO_SEQ= '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
UPDATE TBL_KEP_PO SET IF_FLAG = 'Y', IF_DATE = convert(varchar,getdate(),112) WHERE PLANT = '$G_RS.PLANT$' AND LEGACY_PO_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND LEGACY_PO_SEQ= '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
